title: Limensafe Catalog Schema
description: Structural contract for a limensafe vocabulary catalog. Catalogs contain protected vocabulary and usually live outside public repositories; this schema validates shape only. Semantic hygiene such as over-broad aliases, alias quality, and output-visible ID safety is enforced by loader/linter logic, not by this schema.

$schema.description: Canonical schema URI. Omitted catalogs are accepted with a loader warning during the v0.1.x compatibility window; v0.2.0 will require this field.

catalog_id.description: Stable catalog identifier. This value is output-visible and must be alias-safe; alias-safety is enforced by loader/linter logic.

schema_version.description: Semver for the catalog schema contract. v1.x catalogs validate against this schema; loader policy handles minor/patch warnings and major-mismatch errors.

description.description: Catalog-private description for operators. Not emitted in scan findings.

fingerprint_salt.description: Optional salt input used by fingerprinting. May be a literal or an operator-resolved indirection such as ${env:...}.

entity.description: A protected entity definition. Structure is enforced here; semantic quality and alias-safety are enforced by the loader/linter.

id.description: Entity identifier, unique within a catalog. Output-visible; must be alias-safe by loader/linter policy.

class.description: Entity class used for policy and reporting.

aliases.description: Literal protected strings. Empty arrays are allowed only when tokens or regex_patterns are non-empty.

tokens.description: Additional discrete protected strings to match exactly as case-sensitive whole-token literals. Alias variants do not expand token values.

regex_patterns.description: Regular-expression detector patterns. Regex syntax validity is checked by loader/runtime code.

replacement_for.description: Entity id this entity substitutes for, used by sanctioned codenames.

replacement_suggestion.description: Neutral replacement suggestion. Output-visible and therefore subject to alias-safety checks outside this schema.

disclosure_safe.description: True only after explicit policy review that this entity may live in a public-tier catalog.

notes.description: Catalog-private author note. Not emitted in scan findings.

variants.description: Alias variant generation and matching flags. whole_word is present on introduction because internal-brief has landed.

whole_word.description: Require word boundaries. Loader defaults this to true for aliases shorter than four characters unless explicitly set.

rule_id.description: Rule identifier, unique within a catalog and output-visible.

description.description: Catalog-private rule rationale. Not emitted in scan findings.

terms.description: Two or more entity IDs whose co-occurrence triggers the rule. Referential integrity is checked by loader/runtime code.

window_size.description: Required by near_n_chars and near_n_tokens windows.
